meta.scope: Uruguay batch 2 — External sector (BOP, trade), monetary policy rate & reserves, industrial production, and agro-export anchors.

candidates.title: Balanza de Pagos / Balance of Payments
candidates.description: Quarterly and annual balance of payments covering the current account, capital/financial account and changes in reserve assets.
candidates.notes: Core external-accounts product. Recent current-account balances have been close to zero or mildly in deficit; goods and services trade is typically in surplus, offset by primary-income outflows.

candidates.title: Estadísticas de Comercio Exterior / Merchandise Trade
candidates.description: Monthly and annual statistics of exports and imports of goods. Key traditional exports include beef, cellulose, soybeans, dairy and other agro-industrial products.
candidates.notes: Trade data feed the BOP and national accounts. Agro-industrial products (meat, cellulose, grains, dairy) dominate the export basket.

candidates.title: Tasa de Política Monetaria (TPM) / Policy interest rate
candidates.description: Main monetary-policy instrument of the BCU under the inflation-targeting regime. The rate at which the central bank signals the monetary stance.
candidates.notes: Operational policy rate. Adjusted in discrete steps; recent path has moved from a more restrictive stance toward a more neutral/expansive one (e.g. 5.75% in early 2026 after cumulative cuts).

candidates.title: Activos de reserva / International reserves
candidates.description: Stock of international reserve assets managed by the central bank. Published at high frequency and analysed in the BOP and monetary reports.
candidates.notes: Key external-buffer indicator. Continuously monitored alongside the net international investment position.

candidates.title: Marco de metas de inflación — BCU
candidates.description: Operational monetary-policy framework: explicit inflation targeting. The BCU sets a target range for annual CPI inflation and uses the TPM as the primary instrument.
referenced_by: IPC and inflation analysis that refers to the target band
Market and academic commentary on Uruguayan monetary policy
candidates.notes: Core policy-framework node. Continuously cited as the reference against which inflation outcomes and policy actions are evaluated.

candidates.title: Índice de Volumen Físico de la Industria Manufacturera (IVFIM)
candidates.description: Monthly physical-volume index of manufacturing production. Principal high-frequency industrial-activity indicator.
candidates.notes: Core short-term industry product. Published with variants (with/without refinery, core). Companion indices track hours worked and employment in manufacturing.

candidates.title: Exportaciones de carne / Beef & meat exports
candidates.description: Statistics of beef and other meat production and exports. Long-standing traditional export and a major component of the agro-industrial economy.
candidates.notes: Signature traditional export. Continuously cited in trade and agro-sector analysis; Uruguay is a recognised high-quality beef exporter.

candidates.title: Celulosa y forestal / Pulp & forestry exports
candidates.description: Statistics of pulp (cellulose) and forestry-related production and exports. Major modern agro-industrial export line.
candidates.notes: Structurally important export after large-scale pulp-mill investments. Frequently among the top export products by value.

candidates.title: Sector agropecuario / Agricultural & livestock statistics
candidates.description: Broader agricultural and livestock production and trade statistics (beef, dairy, grains, soybeans, etc.). Backbone of the traditional export economy.
candidates.notes: Primary-sector parent node. Links the commodity-level series (meat, grains, dairy) to the external accounts and to rural economic activity.

candidates.title: Encuesta Anual de Actividad Económica (EAAE)
candidates.description: Annual structural business survey covering value added, employment, investment and other variables across economic activities.
candidates.notes: Structural complement to the high-frequency IVFIM and national accounts. Provides detailed activity-level value-added and employment data.

proposed_edges.basis: Balance of payments is compiled by the Banco Central del Uruguay.
Merchandise trade flows are a primary input into the goods account of the balance of payments.
The policy rate is the primary instrument used to steer inflation toward the target.
The Monetary Policy Report analyses outcomes against the inflation target.
Changes in reserve assets appear in the balance of payments.
Beef is a major traditional export line.
Pulp is a major modern export line.
The manufacturing volume index is produced by INE.
